question: Estimate the number of Indians living in rented housing.
idealClarificationQuestions: Households living in rented homes (not owned)? Yes — household level.
Both formal rent + informal arrangements (chawls, paying guest)? All.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total HH × rental tenure share, segmented urban/rural.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~15-16 crore Indians live in rented housing.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~110M; rented share urban: ~30% (Census 2011 was 28%; rising in metros) = 33M.
~15-16 crore Indians live in rented housing.

calculationFlow: Urban HH: ~110M; rented share urban: ~30% (Census 2011 was 28%; rising in metros) = 33M.
Round: ~15-16 crore Indians live in rented housing.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~15-16 crore Indians live in rented housing.
